name: What kind of preparation is needed before wall tile installation?

mainEntity.name: What kind of preparation is needed before wall tile installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper wall preparation is crucial for a successful tile installation. This typically involves ensuring the surface is clean, dry, structurally sound, and free of any dust, grease, or peeling paint. Any existing damage, holes, or unevenness must be repaired to create a flat substrate. For wet areas like showers, a waterproof membrane or cement board may be required. Adequate preparation prevents future issues such as loose tiles, cracks, or mold growth, ensuring the longevity of your new tile.
acceptedAnswer.description: Preparation requires a clean, dry, sound, and flat wall surface, free of damage. Wet areas may need a waterproof membrane.
